about: Scenario sets and their runs. A set serves at most 5 candidates, then a new version replaces it and it is archived with its results. One run of a set is one candidate commit: its main and its live runs together, every model on it; another run on the same commit uses nothing up (the tuning the rule guards against happens per candidate). The 'before' of a candidate is the previous candidate's run when the scenarios did not change. Every 5th run overall is a regression over the archived sets (evals.py --set, --kind regression). usd is the agent's spend from the report's token counts.
